objective: Verify S3 Technical Solution and Code Demo for fixing masked secret/URI overwrite on Debezium config update, recover, and introspection.

claims.claim: UpdateSystemConnectorConfigHandler.Handle in debezium_connector.go merges current and cmd.Config by only skipping v == KeepSecretSentinel (__KEEP__), so any other value in cmd.Config (such as *** or masked URIs) overwrites merged[k].

In SystemConnectorsHandler.UpdateConfig, validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs(c.UserContext(), req.Config) is called at line 215 before h.updateH.Handle, while validatePostgresConnectorPrereqs at line 48 only skips pass == "" || pass == "***" and does not skip KeepSecretSentinel.

In extractCredentialsAsOptions (system_connectors_credentials.go), SFTP URI parsing assigns opts["username"] = parts[0] when parts[0] != "" without checking !isKeepOrMaskedSecret(parts[0]), whereas parts[1] is checked with !isKeepOrMaskedSecret(parts[1]).

In SourceConnectors.tsx buildConnectorConfig, database.password uses mode === 'edit' ? KEEP_SECRET_SENTINEL : '' so when mode is 'recover' and values.password is empty, database.password becomes empty string and is removed by compactConfig.

The proposed MergeConnectorConfigPreservingSecrets in 09_tasks_solution_debezium_config_masked_password.md skips entries where IsKeepOrMaskedSecret(v) is true, skips empty values for sensitive keys when current[k] is non-empty, and calls RestoreMaskedURI for mongodb.connection.string and fs.uris.

The proposed IsKeepOrMaskedSecret in 09_tasks_solution_debezium_config_masked_password.md returns false for empty strings, true for KeepSecretSentinel, and true when all runes in the trimmed string are '*' or '•'.

In 09_tasks_solution_debezium_config_masked_password.md, DiscoverPostgresTablesRequest adds ConnectorName (`json:"connector_name"`) and resolves pass from h.connectorCfgReader.GetConfig when pass is empty or masked.
KeepSecretSentinel is defined as "__KEEP__" in debezium_connector.go.
In SourceConnectors.tsx, KEEP_SECRET_SENTINEL is defined as the number 999999 instead of "__KEEP__".
MergeConnectorConfigPreservingSecrets in 09_tasks_solution_debezium_config_masked_password.md always returns nil without iterating over current or incoming.
